title: Parallel heads, then an output projection
source_copy: Desktop copy supplied by the instructor

steps.label: Each head learns separate Q, K, and V projections of all input features.
Compute scaled dot-product attention independently in every head.
Concatenate along the feature axis; keep the token rows aligned.
The output projection mixes the concatenated head features.
In the original base model, 512 dimensions divided among 8 heads gives 64 per head.
